mentions.name: Originary
mentions.description: A product built around PEAC, an open protocol for signed interaction records, that makes agent, MCP, and API interactions verifiable across organizational boundaries instead of relying only on logs. Still in an early stage.
mentions.problem: Agent, MCP, and API interactions currently rely only on logs and are not verifiable across organizational boundaries.
